notes:
I found two venues with published hours. Neither page says anything about toddlers, so I left `age_fit` out of both. Both are unconfirmed references, not recommendations. I couldn't find the Biodôme's own page, only third-party listings, so I left it out. I didn't search for playgrounds, so none are included.

- **Montréal Science Centre:** 
Its own visitor page lists Monday through Friday 9 a.m. – 4 p.m. and Saturday and Sunday 10 a.m. – 5 p.m.
 Those are regular hours, not holiday hours. The only holiday-hours pages I found were from earlier years, and I haven't treated them as current. For example, 
the Holiday Alley ran 10am to 5pm from December 27 to 30 in 2024.
 The December 27–30, 2026 hours still need checking with the venue.
- **Biosphère:** The park's page lists dates in December 2026. 
It shows December 27 open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., December 28 closed, and December 29 and 30 open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
 I found no price on it. It also doesn't say whether it suits toddlers.
